summary_1line: Sanjaya lists Pandava allies and battle pairings, while Dhritarashtra fears doom and Duryodhana confidently claims his forces will defeat the Pandavas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Dhritarashtra sits in his dark hall as Sanjaya describes the vast Pandava host assembled with banners and chariots stretching to the horizon.
Warriors of the Pandavas stand beside their chariots while leaders assign each hero a rival for the coming battle.
Duryodhana stands proudly before the court boasting of Bhishma, Drona, Karna, and his mighty army ready for war.
